validity.recommendation: Keep the row; it is a real, distinct trunkline. Apply the endpoint + length corrections noted in the attribution/spec findings.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. IGAT-3 (Third Iran Gas Trunkline) is extensively documented as a physically operating 56-inch national transmission line from the South Pars complex north to the Caspian region. Independent corroboration: digital-oil-gas-map.com (commercial GIS/route vendor) describes an operational IGAT-3, 1266 km, 56 in, operated by National Iranian Gas Company, from South Pars Gas Complex (Jam, Bushehr) to the Rasht Compressor Station (Rasht, Gilan), built as a 993 km core line + 273 km extension; Persian Wikipedia independently states a 1267 km, 90 MMcm/d third trunkline running Asaluyeh -> Jam -> Saveh -> Rasht with 9 compressor stations. The gem.wiki page's own two citations are weak (en.Wikipedia 'Iran Gas Trunkline' generic overview + an eeer.org paper on the Polkalleh compressor station that does not establish this specific line) but the line is confirmed by the two independent sources above. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed gas transmission trunk (IGAT = Iran Gas Trunkline national grid), not gathering/process/feeder, not oil/NGL. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate. It is a distinct member of the parallel IGAT trunk series; route (Asaluyeh->Rasht) differs from P0442 IGAT 2 (Kangan->Qazvin) and P0444 IGAT 4 (Asaluyeh->Shiraz/Esfahan). The GulfPub fuzzy match 'IGAT 3' (Assaluyeh->Saveh, 573 km) is the same line but its length is a short/partial figure; treat GulfPub length as unreliable here. SPEC confirmed: diameter 56 in and capacity 32.85 bcm/y (=90 MMcm/d, the standard design throughput of a 56-in IGAT line; the value being shared with P0442 IGAT 2 is a genuine coincidence of design capacity, not a copy error). See separate attribution + spec findings for the endpoint and length problems.

validity.recommendation: Change EndLocation from Saveh / Markazi to Rasht (Rasht Compressor Station), Gilan. Saveh is a mid-route waypoint, not the terminus. Start (Asaluyeh, Bushehr) is correct.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records EndLocation=Saveh, EndState/Province=Markazi. Two independent sources place the actual terminus at Rasht, Gilan (Caspian region): digital-oil-gas-map.com states the line 'ends at the Rasht Compressor Station in Rasht, Gilan'; Persian Wikipedia gives the route as Asaluyeh -> Jam -> Saveh -> Rasht, i.e. Saveh is an intermediate point and Rasht is the northern end. This looks like GEM captured the older core line (to the Saveh/central-provinces area) and missed the northern extension to Rasht. Start endpoint (Asaluyeh/South Pars, Bushehr) is correct.

validity.recommendation: Review LengthKnown: GEM has 1195 km; independent sources give ~1266-1267 km (993 km core + 273 km Rasht extension). Likely GEM omits the full Rasht extension. Recommend 1266 km with the two refs, or flag as network-length uncertainty.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM LengthKnown=1195 km. digital-oil-gas-map.com states 1266 km (explicitly 993 km IGAT-3 + 273 km extension = 1266); Persian Wikipedia states 1267 km. Both independent sources agree at ~1266-1267 km, materially above the GEM 1195. This is consistent with the endpoint finding (GEM's shorter length + Saveh terminus both suggest the Rasht extension is under-counted). Diameter (56 in) and capacity (32.85 bcm/y = 90 MMcm/d) are corroborated and correct.

routes.start_name: Asaluyeh / South Pars Gas Complex, Jam County, Bushehr Province, Iran
routes.end_name: Rasht Compressor Station, Rasht, Gilan Province, Iran
routes.corridor_desc: Trunk runs north from the South Pars complex at Asaluyeh/Jam on the Bushehr Gulf coast, up across the interior of central Iran (through Fars/Isfahan/Markazi corridor) to the Saveh area in Markazi Province, then continues north to the Rasht Compressor Station in Gilan on the Caspian plain. ~1266 km total (993 km core line + 273 km Rasht extension), 56 in, 9 compressor stations. Endpoints and the Jam/Saveh waypoints are independently sourced (named facilities/cities, coordinates from those known places); the precise between-waypoint alignment is NOT sourced here (a commercial GIS route exists at digital-oil-gas-map but its coordinates were not obtained), so the corridor is bounded by the four named nodes rather than a traced centerline.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from two independent sources agreeing on Asaluyeh/South Pars (start) and Rasht Compressor Station, Gilan (end), with Jam and Saveh as named on-route nodes. Coordinates are the standard coordinates of those named places (Asaluyeh, Jam, Saveh, Rasht) — not fabricated and not a traced pipeline centerline. Current GEM sheet endpoints ('Asia'/'Asia' in RouteNotes; Saveh terminus in the row) are wrong/loose; this corridor corrects the end to Rasht. No coordinates invented; no routes-repo edit made.

summary: IGAT 3 (P0443) real, gas transmission trunk, not a duplicate; but END endpoint wrong (Saveh/Markazi -> should be Rasht/Gilan) and length low (1195 vs sourced ~1266 km); diameter 56in and capacity 32.85 bcm/y confirmed.
